styleReference.usage: Visual direction only: top-down astronaut, crisp outlines, shaded pixels, and playful space colors. No image or pixels copied into the game.

textures.purpose: Separate, non-blocking pixel-art learning terminal at seven Moon Base locations
Separate animated Earth water cargo pod at each scheduled delivery
Greenhouse growth-stage overlay; original procedural pixel sprites
Four-direction astronaut idle and walk frames

notes: Each building and character frame is an independent Phaser canvas texture. The ground is assembled from repeating tiles, separate crater and rock props, and pixel-snapped path and sky graphics. Future features should preserve scale, outline, palette, and per-object rendering.
